speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit. I have laid the loaf to the notch. Two fingers and more. Whose fault do you think it is?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A married couple's, Mistress, who can't agree.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: That is the first sound doctrine I ever had from you.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Hold your tongue and pour the small beer, Alse.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My jaw is whole enough for the crust. I am not making a second dinner of the answer.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then eat. Doctrine is not a dinner. The Chaucer can stay where you left it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is off the book. I put him on the settle.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Two fingers, and you knew whose fault it was. I will not ask you twice.
